description: Get your live open positions across connected exchanges (MEXC, Binance, Lighter) and Hyperliquid perps. Shows entry price, mark price, unrealized PnL, leverage, margin, and liquidation price for each position. Hyperliquid positions also carry the user's REAL stop-loss and targets (price, distance %, PnL at that price), risk:reward, pending orders, when the position opened, funding since open and — logged in — Asrai's trailing-stop setting (e.g. 1.5× ATR 1D). For a position the user already holds, ALWAYS read this first and use their real stop/targets — never invent ATR stops with trade_plan / coin_brief for it; if stop_loss is null, say there is no stop (an ATR level may be offered, labelled as a suggestion). MEXC / Binance / Lighter need exchange API keys — add them via /exchange_apis in the Asrai Telegram bot. Hyperliquid needs no keys: it reads the wallet the user trades with on asrai.me/perps (read-only). Use when asked: 'show my positions', 'what am I trading', 'my open trades', 'my PnL', 'my exchange positions'.
name: positions
title: Open trade positions
